label: Read aloud
description: Offer spoken instructions or text alongside the written version. Let the learner choose whether to listen.

label: Line focus
description: Offer a reading guide that shows one line at a time when a task contains longer passages.

label: Visual steps
description: Show the order of the task with a short sequence the learner can refer back to.

label: Task breaker
description: Split a task with several parts into smaller steps, with a clear place to pause.

label: Calm break
description: Make an optional pause available during a longer task. A break should never depend on performance.

label: Writing support
description: Offer a writing scaffold or an alternative way to draft an answer when the task involves writing.

label: Pronunciation practice
description: Offer optional word practice in Pronunciation Buddy when speaking practice is part of the task. Respect the learner's chosen way to communicate.
